high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a webpage from the website "myinnercreative.com." The page title is "Pulling it all together," and it discusses five "rules" that creative people break to form a coherent mindset. The rules are listed as follows: Breadth fuels depth. Collect more dots. Progress reveals the plan. Start before you're certain. Risk is the rent you pay for originality. Stay hungry, stay foolish. Vision outpaces consensus. Listen to needs, not just wants. **Agility beats bureaucracy. Hoist
